question: Two CRISPR guide RNAs, Guide A and Guide B, are tested for editing efficiency: Guide A succeeds in 45 out of 60 trials, and Guide B succeeds in 38 out of 60 trials. Using Beta(1,1) priors for both, compute their full posterior probability distributions, calculate and report the posterior mean efficiency for each guide, and generate a plot comparing the two posterior distributions.

files.eval_guideline: Plot must show both posterior Beta distribution curves with annotated posterior means; axis labels, color scheme, and styling may differ.
